package competency

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client Client) DiscoverTargets(ctx context.Context, stacks []string) ([]domain.LearningTargetDescriptor, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"schema": "learning-target-candidate-request.v1", "stacks": stacks})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/learning-targets/candidates", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("competency discovery returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: 512<<10 + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var result struct {
		Schema  string                            `json:"schema"`
		Targets []domain.LearningTargetDescriptor `json:"targets"`
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 ||
		result.Schema != "learning-target-candidates.v1" || len(result.Targets) == 0 || len(result.Targets) > 200 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	seen := make(map[domain.LearningTargetRef]struct{}, len(result.Targets))
	for _, target := range result.Targets {
		if !validTargetRef(target.Ref) || strings.TrimSpace(target.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(target.Description) == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[target.Ref]; duplicate {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[target.Ref] = struct{}{}
		for _, prerequisite := range target.Prerequisites {
			if !validTargetRef(prerequisite) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	return result.Targets, nil
}

func (client Client) ResolveExactTargets(ctx context.Context, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) error {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"schema": "learning-target-resolution-request.v1", "targets": targets})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/learning-targets/resolve", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusUnprocessableEntity || response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return fmt.Errorf("competency resolver returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: 256<<10 + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var result struct {
		Schema   string                     `json:"schema"`
		Resolved []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"resolved"`
		Missing  []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"missing"`
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 || result.Schema != "learning-target-resolution.v1" || len(result.Missing) > 0 || len(result.Resolved) != len(targets) {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	for index := range targets {
		if result.Resolved[index] != targets[index] {
			return domain.ErrNotFound
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
}

var _ domain.CompetencyResolver = Client{}

func validTargetRef(target domain.LearningTargetRef) bool {
	if target.Type != "concept" && target.Type != "capability" {
		return false
	}
	validSegment := func(value string, maximum int) bool {
		if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > maximum || !((value[0] >= 'a' && value[0] <= 'z') || (value[0] >= '0' && value[0] <= '9')) {
			return false
		}
		for _, character := range value {
			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || strings.ContainsRune("._:/-", character) {
				continue
			}
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	return validSegment(target.Key, 255) && validSegment(target.Version, 64)
}
